cards.text: New king in Judah, friend. Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, makes Zedekiah son of Josiah the king, in place of Coniah son of Jehoiakim. So the big question is whether this new king will listen to the LORD.

cards.question: King Zedekiah, his officers and the people of the land obey the words the LORD spoke through Jeremiah the prophet.

cards.text: Zedekiah, his officers and the people of the land refuse to obey. And YET King Zedekiah sends two men to Jeremiah: Jehucal son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the priest, the son of Maaseiah.

cards.question: What message does King Zedekiah send to Jeremiah through Jehucal and Zephaniah?

answers.text: Pray to the LORD our God for us
Give us a sign from the LORD our God
Offer a sacrifice to the LORD for us

cards.text: That's like leaving every one of a friend's texts on read, then sending one of your own: "Hey, can you do me a favor?" And right now Jeremiah is free to come and go among the people, because nobody has put him in prison yet.
Meanwhile, the Chaldeans, Babylon's army, are besieging Jerusalem. Then they hear a report: Pharaoh's army has left Egypt.

cards.question: When the Chaldeans hear that Pharaoh's army has left Egypt, they ___ Jerusalem.

cards.text: Then the word of the LORD comes to Jeremiah, with a message for the king of Judah who sent to Him. It's about Pharaoh's army, the one that marched out to help Judah.

cards.question: Pharaoh's army marched out to help Judah. What does the LORD say that army will do?

answers.text: Go back to its own land of Egypt
Drive the Chaldeans out for good

cards.question: Once Pharaoh's army goes home, the LORD says the Chaldeans will come back, capture Jerusalem and burn it down.

cards.text: Then the LORD says, “Do not deceive yourselves by saying, ‘The Chaldeans will go away for good,’ for they will not!” It's the snooze button, friend: the alarm goes quiet, you feel GREAT, and nine minutes later it's BACK.

cards.question: The LORD says even if Judah struck down the whole Chaldean army and only wounded men were left in their tents, what would those wounded men do?

answers.text: Get up and burn the city down
Pack up their tents and go home
Send word to Babylon for help

cards.text: Back to that moment the Chaldean army pulled away from Jerusalem, for fear of Pharaoh's army. Jeremiah starts to leave Jerusalem for the land of Benjamin, where he's from (Jeremiah 1:1).

cards.question: Jeremiah heads out of Jerusalem toward the land of Benjamin. What is he going there to do?

answers.text: Claim his portion there among the people
Hide away from King Zedekiah's men
Bring the LORD's word to the towns

cards.text: He makes it as far as the Gate of Benjamin. That's where the captain of the guard, Irijah son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah, grabs him.

cards.question: Irijah, the captain of the guard, grabs Jeremiah and accuses him of deserting to the ___.

cards.text: Jeremiah fires right back: “I am not deserting to the Chaldeans!” Picture getting stopped at the store exit like you stole something, with the receipt RIGHT there in your hand.

cards.question: Irijah won't listen to Jeremiah and arrests him. Who does Irijah take Jeremiah to?
When Irijah brings Jeremiah in, the officials are ___ with him.

cards.text: The officials beat Jeremiah and put him in jail in the house of Jonathan the scribe, which had been made into a prison.
So Jeremiah goes into a cell in the dungeon, and he stays there a long time. I know a little about long stretches in the dark from my years at the back of a junk drawer, and I think this one hurts.
Later, King Zedekiah sends for Jeremiah and receives him in his palace. Then he asks him privately, “Is there a word from the LORD?”

cards.question: After a long time in the dungeon, what word from the LORD does Jeremiah give King Zedekiah?

answers.text: Zedekiah will be handed to Babylon's king
The Chaldeans will go away for good
Pharaoh's army will come to rescue him

cards.question: Then Jeremiah asks King Zedekiah a question of his own: how has he sinned against the king, his servants or these people, that the king has put him in prison?
Jeremiah also asks King Zedekiah where his own prophets are now. What had those prophets claimed?

answers.text: Babylon's king would not come against them
Pharaoh's army would stay and fight for them
Egypt would rebuild the city's walls

cards.text: Those prophets said Babylon's king would NOT come against them, and the Chaldeans had already been besieging Jerusalem! Then Jeremiah brings the king a petition: “Do not send me back to the house of Jonathan the scribe, or I will die there.”

cards.question: King Zedekiah sends Jeremiah back to the house of Jonathan the scribe.
Instead, King Zedekiah has Jeremiah placed in the courtyard of the guard, with a loaf of bread every day from the street of the ___.

cards.text: A whole STREET of bakers, friend, and I have to send out invitations just to get one in my kitchen! Jeremiah gets his daily loaf until all the bread in the city is gone.
So Jeremiah stays in the courtyard of the guard. Hang on to your apron, friend, because Jeremiah's story is still in the oven.
